reception: Reception in the citing literature runs unusually deep for its size: a large share of the citations come from work that ran the compiler rather than merely naming it. SUIF Explorer built its interactive parallelization support on the system; compiler-directed page coloring drew its parallelized applications from it; and a line of work on software distributed shared memory by Han, Tseng, and Keleher used its output to study runtime support for compiler-parallelized codes. Later work extended the analysis toward coarse-grain pipelining on FPGAs, and predicated array data-flow analysis measured itself against the paper's results. The rest of the record largely cites the coverage figures as evidence of what interprocedural analysis can find.
